rca_of_issue: RCA: Launch console warning originates from LaunchScreen Animated.timing configured with useNativeDriver=true in web runtime where native animated module is unavailable, causing fallback warning. Repro: load app cold at 390x844 and inspect console during splash. Mitigation: conditional useNativeDriver=false on Platform.OS==='web' for launch animations. Additional aborted requests appear tied to preview edge/challenge/network behavior and did not block render/transition.
